title: Semantic-Aware Random Convolution and Source Matching for Domain Generalization in Medical Image Segmentation
mechanism: Different random convolutions per labelled region during training; test-time intensity mapping of target images toward source.
adaptation: Use only the training half, with the same crack/inactive exclusion as SLAug; skip test-time mapping (intensity normalisation already failed here).
min_experiment: Run only if SLAug arm passes: PF + semantic RandConv vs PF + SLAug, 3 seeds; keep the better.
evidence: R: beats prior DG methods in most cross-modality and cross-centre settings (abdominal, whole-heart, prostate), matching in-domain baseline in several.
prior_overlap: Test-time half overlaps BRIEF s5 intensity normalisation (fail); training half untested.
